# Collancer

> India's first structured influencer booking marketplace, powered by Cleo AI.

## What Collancer Does

Collancer solves the ₹3,500 crore problem with India's influencer economy — which runs entirely on WhatsApp DMs, personal UPI transfers, and unverified follower counts, with no contracts, no payment protection, and no infrastructure.

Collancer provides:
- A structured marketplace to discover, book, and pay verified Indian creators
- AI-powered matching via **Cleo AI** — describe what you need in plain English
- 20,000+ verified creators across 25 content niches
- Escrow payment protection via Razorpay (UPI, card, net banking)
- 100% automatic refund if creator rejects booking or misses deadline
- 6 promotion types: Instagram Story, Instagram Reel, YouTube Video, YouTube Shorts, Personal Video, Personal Ad
- Campaign brief marketplace (Requirements Marketplace) where creators bid on business briefs
- Real-time campaign tracking and delivery confirmation

## Who Uses Collancer

**Businesses / Brands:**
- D2C brands in fashion, beauty, fitness, food, tech, and more
- SMBs and startups wanting verified influencer marketing
- Marketing teams at mid-to-large Indian companies

**Creators / Influencers:**
- Instagram creators (nano to mega)
- YouTube creators
- Multi-platform content creators
- Verified Indian influencers across 25 niches

## Key Features

- **Cleo AI**: Natural language creator search, head-to-head comparisons, reach estimates, ROI projections
- **Smart Discovery**: Filter by niche, city, budget, platform, follower count, engagement rate
- **Secure Payments**: Razorpay escrow — money never goes directly to creator before delivery
- **100% Refund Guarantee**: Automatic refund on rejection or missed deadline
- **6 Promotion Types**: Stories, Reels, Videos, Shorts, Personal Videos, Personal Ads
- **Requirements Marketplace**: Post a brief, receive creator proposals
- **Verified Profiles**: All creators verified within 24 hours, real metrics not self-reported
- **Earnings Dashboard** for creators: bookings, payments, payout history

## 25 Content Niches

Fashion, Beauty & Makeup, Food & Beverages, Fitness & Health, Tech & Gadgets, Gaming, Travel, Finance & Investing, Wellness & Mental Health, Cars & Automotive, Home & Interior, Shopping & E-commerce, Jewelry & Accessories, Baby & Parenting, Sports, Music, Books & Education, Sustainability & Eco, Real Estate, Film & Entertainment, Pet Care, Photography, Comedy & Memes, Crypto & Web3, B2B & Business

## Cities Covered

Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Surat, Lucknow, Kanpur, Nagpur, Indore, Bhopal, and 200+ tier-2 and tier-3 Indian cities.

## Pricing

Free for creators to list. Businesses pay per booking with a small platform commission. First campaign at zero platform fees.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Collancer?**
A: Collancer is India's first structured influencer booking marketplace. Brands can discover, book, and pay verified Indian creators across 25 niches in under 2 minutes, powered by Cleo AI.

**Q: How long does it take to book an influencer?**
A: Under 2 minutes — search, select promotion type, fill brief, pay securely.

**Q: Is my payment safe?**
A: Yes. All payments are held in Razorpay escrow and released only after delivery.

**Q: What if a creator doesn't deliver?**
A: You receive a 100% automatic refund — no forms, no disputes.

**Q: How are creators verified?**
A: Collancer's team manually verifies every creator within 24 hours of profile creation, checking real follower counts, engagement authenticity, and content quality.

**Q: Is Collancer available across all of India?**
A: Yes. Collancer covers creators from all major Indian cities including Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and 200+ tier-2 cities.

**Q: What payment methods does Collancer support?**
A: UPI, Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, and Wallets via Razorpay.

**Q: Is Collancer free for creators?**
A: Yes. Creators list for free. Collancer takes a small commission only on successful bookings.
